gen-gf-offside-gf-glegoo: Wide-set and unhurried. Offside spaces its open-mouthed curves out like a statement, while Glegoo, a serif with a tall lowercase and generous counters, settles in beneath it with a more literary, editorial warmth.
gen-gf-offside-gf-hanuman: Offside draws every stroke at a single thickness, with curves that never quite close and wide tracking. Hanuman, a serif with a high-waisted lowercase, follows with a traditional, refined texture that gives the page something softer to land on.
gen-gf-offside-gf-kadwa: Commanding, with a wire-thin line. Offside is best when it is shouting a few wide-spaced words, whereas Kadwa, a text serif with a large x-height and open curves, is best when it settles into classic, editorial running text.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noticia-text: Curves that refuse to close, spaced wide and held level. Noticia Text, a serif with lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height, adds a dignified, literary voice that makes Offside's expressive heading feel deliberate.
gen-gf-offside-gf-pridi: Slim joins, wide tracking, no fuss. Pridi, a text serif with small letters standing nearly capital-sized and generous gaps at the curve ends, would carry a long passage with a classic, refined steadiness under that heading.
gen-gf-offside-gf-scope-one: Commanding from the first line, Offside keeps its rounds and stems at one weight with curves left open. Scope One, a text serif with counters spilling into the surrounding space, is the real strength here, giving the pair a traditional, refined softness.
gen-gf-offside-gf-slabo-13px: Offside has no stroke modulation at all, just open curves. It does best as a wide-tracked, commanding headline, while Slabo 13px, a serif with large counters in its tall a, e and s, does best as bookish, dignified running text.
gen-gf-offside-gf-suwannaphum: Curves that never close, drawn with a ruler-like constant line, mark Offside out at once. And Suwannaphum, a serif with a very open c and a high x-height, brings a dignified, editorial weight that gives the pair its strength.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-epunda-slab: Big lowercase, open curves, one line weight throughout. Epunda Slab, a classic serif with a visibly gaping c and tall rounded forms, takes over below Oxanium and gives the page a dignified, settled footing.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-fauna-one: Oxanium earns its keep big and short, where its high x-height and stems sharing one thickness look commanding. Fauna One, a text serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, brings a literary, dignified texture to everything after.
